instructions: Dice the 3 tomatoes into small pieces and put them in a large bowl.
Mince half of the red onion. That should be about 1/2 cup. Add it to the bowl.
Chop the parsley leaves until you have 1/4 cup and add them to the bowl.
Crumble the 9 oz of shanklish into the bowl with your fingers, in small pieces.
Pour in the 1/4 cup olive oil and squeeze in the juice of half the lemon. Stir gently until everything is coated.
Don't add salt. The shanklish is salty enough.
If you have time, cover the bowl and chill it for 30 minutes. Otherwise serve it right away.
Serve it cold in bowls. Leftovers keep in a covered container in the fridge for 1 day.
method_notes: Every version is the same short list: shanklish, tomato, onion, olive oil, with parsley in most. They differ on extras and oil: one adds mint and lemon, one leaves out lemon and uses far less oil. This one follows the lead's list, adds the lemon from the second source, and uses a middle amount of oil. All the ratings are very small, so the lead is a fallback; no salt is added in either source. Bread is left off to keep it gluten-free.
